content:
# Testament of Judah — 4
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

**1:1** The-copy-of-the-words-of-Judah, which-he-spoke to-his-sons before-he-died.
**1:2** They-gathered-themselves-together and-came-to-him, and-he-said-to-them:
**1:3** Hearken, my-children, to-Judah your-father; and-give-heed, my-sons, to-the-words-of-him-who-loves-you.
**1:4** I-was-the-fourth-son-born-to-my-father Jacob; and-my-mother Leah called-me Judah, saying: I-give-thanks-to-the-LORD.
**1:5** And I-was-swift-in-my-youth, and-obedient-to-my-father in-every-thing.
**1:6** And I-honoured-my-mother and-my-mother's-sister.
**1:7** And-it-came-to-pass when-I-became-a-man that-my-father Jacob blessed-me, saying: Thou-shalt-be-a-king, prospering-in-all-things.

**2:1** And-the-LORD showed-me-favour-in-all-my-works, both-in-the-field-and-in-the-house.
**2:2** I-know-that I-ran-upon-a-lion, and-rescued-a-kid-out-of-its-mouth.
**2:3** And-I-seized-a-wild-boar-and-tore-it-in-pieces.
**2:4** I-outran-a-deer and-caught-it and-prepared-it-for-my-father to-eat.
**2:5** And-a-wild-mare I-overtook-and-tamed-it.
**2:6** I-slew-a-leopard, and-rescued-a-lamb-out-of-its-paws.
**2:7** I-caught-a-bear-by-its-paw, and-hurled-it-down-the-cliff; and-it-was-crushed.
**2:8** I-outran-the-wild-boar-and-tore-it-as-I-ran; a-lion I-turned-to-flight-with-my-noise-in-its-hunt.

**3:1** And-a-huge-man with-his-armour we-came-upon him-at-Hazor, fighting against-us;
**3:2** and I-seized-his-shield, and-hurled-him-down, and-crushed-him.
**3:3** I-fought-with-this-one-of-the-kings-of-the-Canaanites, and-I-smote-him-upon-the-shin, and-with-the-marrow-of-his-shinbone I-healed-a-horse.
**3:4** I-found-a-man with-iron-armour, and I-took-away-his-armour-and-put-it-on-myself, and-hurled-him-from-the-wall.
**3:5** And I-slew-Achor the-king, a-man-of-giant-stature, hurling-his-shield before-him four-cubits, and-grasping-his-hand, and-throwing-him-down and-killing-him-upon-his-shield.
**3:6** I-wrestled-with-this-man and-he-breathed-out-his-life in-the-fight.
**3:7** And I-had-Saul the-son-of-Adulam, and-he-was-a-king and-a-mighty-man, and-I-fought-with-him.
**3:8** I-pursued-him and-I-seized-him and-I-overcame-him and-slew-him.

**4:1** And-before-I-took-to-wife Bathshua the-Canaanitess, I-had-taken to-wife Tamar, the-virgin of-Mesopotamia.
**4:2** For-Hirah, the-shepherd-of-Adullam, was-a-friend-of-mine.
**4:3** And-he-spoke-well-of-the-daughter-of-Bathshua to-me, and-I-married-her.
**4:4** She-bore-me Er, and-Onan, and-Shelah; and two-of-them the-LORD slew in-their-wickedness, and-Shelah-lived, and-ye-are-his-children.

**5:1** And-after-eighteen-years, while-my-wife Bathshua was-alive, I-drank-wine in-excess with-Hirah the-Adullamite.
**5:2** And-I-saw-Tamar, the-widow-of-my-son, adorned-and-sitting-by-the-gate.
**5:3** For-the-custom-of-the-Amorites was-that-they-who-were-about-to-marry-sat-in-fornication-at-the-city-gate for-seven-days.
**5:4** Being-intoxicated-with-wine, I-did-not-recognise-her; and-her-beauty-deceived-me, because-of-the-way-she-had-adorned-herself-to-deceive-me.
**5:5** And I-turned-aside-to-her, and-said: Let-me-go-in-to-thee. And-she-said: What-wilt-thou-give-me? And I-gave-her-my-staff-and-my-girdle-and-the-diadem-of-my-kingdom.
**5:6** And I-went-in-to-her, and-she-conceived.
**5:7** And-not-knowing-what-I-had-done, I-wished-to-slay-her; but-she-secretly-sent-my-pledges, and-put-me-to-shame.
**5:8** And-when I-called-her-to-me, I-heard-also-the-secret-words-which-I-spoke-when-lying-with-her in-my-drunkenness; and I-could-not-slay-her, for-it-was-from-the-LORD.

**6:1** For-I-said: Lest-haply-I-also-should-be-condemned-for-having-sinned-in-that-I-had-wished-to-slay-her-by-deception, I-will-not-again-drink-wine.
**6:2** And-from-that-day I-drank-no-wine until-my-old-age, neither-did-I-rejoice-in-any-pleasant-thing; for-I-knew-that-I-had-sinned-concerning-Tamar, and-I-had-not-kept-the-law-of-the-LORD.
**6:3** For-even-the-patriarch-of-my-father-had-no-pleasure-in-my-act.
**6:4** And I-ceased-henceforth-to-drink-wine-and-flesh for-fourteen-years.

**7:1** And I-tell-you these-things, my-children, that-ye-may-not-fall-into-the-snare-of-wine.
**7:2** For-wine-turns-the-mind-away-from-the-truth, and-inspires-the-passion-of-lust, and-leads-the-eyes-into-error.
**7:3** For-the-spirit-of-fornication-hath-wine-as-a-minister-to-give-pleasure-to-the-mind; for-these-two-also-take-away-the-power-of-a-man.
**7:4** For-if-a-man-drinks-wine-to-drunkenness, it-disturbs-the-mind-with-filthy-thoughts-leading-to-fornication, and-heats-the-body-to-carnal-union; and-if-the-occasion-of-the-lust-be-present, he-worketh-the-sin, and-is-not-ashamed.
**7:5** Such-is-the-inebriated-man, my-children; for-he-who-is-drunken-reverences-no-man.
**7:6** For-lo, it-made-me-also-to-err, so-that-I-was-not-ashamed-of-the-multitude-in-the-city, in-that-before-the-eyes-of-all-I-turned-aside-to-Tamar, and-I-wrought-a-great-sin; and-I-uncovered-the-covering-of-my-sons'-shame.

**8:1** After-drinking-wine I-had-no-fear-of-God, and-I-did-not-remember-the-commandment-of-my-father, and-I-went-in-to-her.
**8:2** For-those-who-are-not-drunk-with-wine, who-have-the-fear-of-God, do-not-commit-fornication.
**8:3** But-the-man-who-is-drunk-with-wine honours-no-man; and-by-drunkenness has-the-mind-been-corrupted of-many-from-the-beginning.

**9:1** And-now, my-children, I-command-you not-to-love-money, not-to-gaze-on-the-beauty-of-women; because-for-the-sake-of-money-and-beauty-I-was-led-astray-to-Bathshua-the-Canaanitess.
**9:2** For-I-know-that-my-seed-shall-go-into-captivity-through-these-two-things.
**9:3** For-even-the-wise-men-among-my-sons-shall-they-make-to-err, and-they-shall-cause-the-kingdom-of-Judah-to-be-diminished, which-the-LORD-gave-me-because-of-my-obedience-to-my-father.
**9:4** For-I-never-caused-grief-to-my-father Jacob; for-all-things-whatsoever-he-commanded-me-I-did.
**9:5** And-Isaac the-father-of-my-father blessed-me-to-be-king-in-Israel, and-Jacob further-blessed-me-in-like-manner.

**10:1** And-I-know-that-from-me-shall-the-kingdom-be-established.
**10:2** And-I-have-read-in-the-books-of-Enoch the-righteous-how-great-evils-ye-shall-do-in-the-last-days.
**10:3** Take-heed therefore, my-children, of-fornication, and-the-love-of-money, and-hearken-to-Judah your-father.
**10:4** For-these-things-withdraw-you-from-the-law-of-God, and-blind-the-inclination-of-the-soul, and-teach-arrogance, and-suffer-not-a-man-to-have-compassion-upon-his-neighbour.
**10:5** They-rob-his-soul-of-all-goodness, and-oppress-him-with-toils-and-troubles, and-drive-away-sleep-from-him, and-devour-his-flesh.
**10:6** And-he-hinders-the-sacrifices-of-God; and-he-remembers-not-the-blessing-of-God, and-hearkens-not-to-a-prophet-when-he-speaketh, and-resenteth-the-words-of-godliness.
**10:7** For-he-is-enslaved-to-two-contrary-passions, and-cannot-obey-God, because-they-have-blinded-his-soul, and-he-walks-in-the-day-as-in-the-night.

**11:1** But-keep-the-commandments-of-the-LORD my-children, and-honour-Levi, that-ye-may-dwell-in-safety.
**11:2** For-the-salvation-of-Israel-shall-arise-from-the-tribe-of-Judah and-of-Levi; the-LORD-will-appear-among-men saving-every-race-of-Israel.
**11:3** For-the-LORD-shall-bless-Levi, and-Judah's-people-shall-be-glorified.
**11:4** For-the-LORD shall-raise-up-from-Levi-as-it-were-a-High-priest, and-from-Judah-as-it-were-a-King, God-and-man; he-shall-save-all-the-Gentiles-and-the-race-of-Israel.

---
*End of Testament of Judah*
